title: New Stable version immediately crashes
symptom: Immediately after upgrading to the new stable build, the app will not open. Upon tapping the app icon, the app launches a black background, then an error opens saying xDrip+ has stopped.
cause: This issue only affects LG Android 6 phones. It may be a bug in the LG framework or the android drawable support library.
fix: The issue was resolved by trying the 28th Sept nightly build, which launches the app without any crashes or errors.
evidence_quote: Success! The new build launches the app without any crashes or errors. Seems to work as normal - no issues found.
